Metadata.title: CreatorOS — Verified creators, managed by an agency
Metadata.description: Find, hire, and manage collaborations with verified content creators in one platform.

Home.heroTitleSans: A process that stays on track.
Home.heroBody: Discover verified talent, send briefs, manage revisions, and settle payments—with agency quality control at every step.
Home.heroVisualAlt: Three Southeast Asian content creators producing food, technology, and lifestyle content
Home.rosterBody: From natural-feeling UGC to multi-platform campaign production—choose by niche, location, audience, and content format.
Home.workflowTitle: One flow, from discovery to publish.
Home.workflowBody: CreatorOS keeps everyone working from the same brief, status, and file version.
Home.stepOneBody: Filter verified creators around your campaign requirements.
Home.stepTwoBody: Manage briefs, submissions, feedback, and revisions in context.
Home.stepThreeBody: Approvals, payments, commissions, and payouts stay recorded.
Home.agencyTitle: A marketplace with people behind it.
Home.agencyBody: The agency is more than an intermediary. We verify creators, help with matching, and protect the quality bar from start to finish.
Home.finalTitle: Your next campaign starts with the right creator.
Home.finalBody: Build a shortlist, send a brief, and manage production without scattered spreadsheets.
Home.footerNote: Creator names and data in this preview are illustrative.

Creators.title: Verified creators for your next idea
Creators.description: A Phase 0 directory preview using illustrative data. Production search, filters, and data arrive in Phase 3.
Creators.emptyTitle: The live directory is coming soon
Creators.emptyBody: Locale, SEO, and creator-card foundations are ready to connect to the API after creator foundation is complete.
